purpose: Reconstruct what every Phase 98 checkpoint entry means so Phase 99 never re-searches a part or counts a status twice.

definitions.FIRST_EBAY_LINK: exact pass finished and the part has an ACTIVE eBay offer now
definitions.RESEARCHED_NO_EXACT_LISTING: both marketplaces answered the exact-number search with zero listings; no listing exists to prove identity against
definitions.RESEARCHED_LISTINGS_NO_ACCEPT: listings were returned but none produced an ACCEPT (no accepting offer after shipping/price gates)
definitions.RESEARCHED_REVIEW_ONLY: only NEEDS_EVIDENCE candidates (title-only or unproven MPN)
definitions.UNFINISHED: a marketplace errored, so the planned searches on both marketplaces did not complete
definitions.NOT_IN_EXACT_CHECKPOINT: in the queue but absent from the exact checkpoint (must be 0)
definitions.alternative_pass_executed: the part was re-searched with model + part-type terms in retry_00..02
